periods.label: Lisha's younger sister
periods.summary: Lisha's younger sister. She finds Lisha working late in the palace Drag-Ride hangar on the wedding eve, worries about her safety and emotions, and then quietly leaves when Lux arrives.

lisharhti-atismata.summary: Cares about her anxiety and asks why she loves Lux.

lux-arcadia.summary: Trusts that he will not hurt Lisha.

key_events.summary: Keeps Lisha company in the hangar until Lux returns under the stars.
